tips.title: Glove Rise Set→Lift · Slider (SL) vs Changeup (CH)
tips.cue: glove rise from set to lift
tips.target_body_part: glove rise from set to lift
tips.what_to_spot: On sliders, the glove rises clearly from a lower set into a high carry near the chin at peak lift; on changeups the glove path stays flatter with less rise into lift.
tips.direction: Big glove rise into lift → Slider; flat / little rise → Changeup.
tips.lookFor: Big glove rise into lift → Slider; flat / little rise → Changeup. (4.09× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove rise from set to lift
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 64.0% SL (vs 60.4% base).
tips.scouting_note: Roupp-style visual QA 2026-10-05: five distinct tell families (not glove-height/rise duplicates); FDR not used as publish gate; tipsProtected.

tips.title: Glove Flare at Lift · Fastball (FF) vs Slider (SL)
tips.cue: glove flare at lift
tips.what_to_spot: Distinct from the glove-rise tell: on four-seamers Scolari flares the glove wider off the chest midline at peak lift; on sliders the glove stays tucked tighter to the torso through the same window.
tips.direction: Wider glove flare off midline at lift → Fastball; tighter glove to midline → Slider.
tips.lookFor: Wider glove flare off midline at lift → Fastball; tighter glove to midline → Slider. (2.07× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove flare at lift
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 51.7% FF (vs 50.0% base).
tips.scouting_note: Roupp-style visual QA 2026-10-05: distinct cue family from the re-scored stretch pool (runs/straily_scolari_full_pool.json); readable separation + holdout precision above base rate; A/B frame pack not yet cut. FDR not used as publish gate; tipsProtected.

tips.title: Depth of Sit at the Set · Fastball (FF) vs Curveball (CU)
tips.cue: how deep he sits in the set
tips.target_body_part: back-leg knee bend / hip height at the set
tips.what_to_spot: Not a glove cue: on four-seamers Scolari stands taller and straighter over the rubber at the set; on curveballs he sinks into a deeper back-leg sit before the leg lift starts.
tips.direction: Taller, straighter set → Fastball; deeper sit into the back leg → Curveball.
tips.lookFor: Taller, straighter set → Fastball; deeper sit into the back leg → Curveball. (1.91× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: back-leg knee bend / hip height at the set
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 64.7% FF (vs 62.7% base).
tips.scouting_note: Roupp-style visual QA 2026-10-05: distinct cue family from the re-scored stretch pool (runs/straily_scolari_full_pool.json); readable separation + holdout precision above base rate; A/B frame pack not yet cut. FDR not used as publish gate; tipsProtected.

tips.title: Hand Depth in Glove at Lift · Slider (SL) vs Changeup (CH)

tips.direction: Hand further out of glove → Slider (SL); hand buried deeper → Changeup (CH).
tips.lookFor: Hand further out of glove → Slider (SL); hand buried deeper → Changeup (CH). (1.91× floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: how deep the hand is in the glove at lift
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 60.5% SL (vs 60.4% base).
tips.scouting_note: Hand-insertion pair 2026-10-05: CF deep-in-glove (hand_gap_at_lift) + grip-showing (hand_vis_at_lift) from stretch pool / spot_diff; FDR not publish gate; tipsProtected.

tips.title: Grip Showing at Lift · 4-Seam Fastball (FF) vs Curveball (CU)

tips.title: Glove Height at Leg Lift · CH vs SL · Runner on 1st or 1st & 3rd
tips.cue: glove height at leg lift
tips.what_to_spot: Classic slide-step cell (man on first, or first & third). On changeups Straily carries the glove much higher through the lift apex; on sliders the glove stays near the belt. This is the setting where the tell pops (~5.9× floor).
tips.direction: Higher glove at peak leg lift → Changeup; belt-line glove through lift → Slider.
tips.lookFor: Higher glove at peak leg lift → Changeup; belt-line glove through lift → Slider. (5.87× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: glove height at leg lift
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 53.7% CH (vs 51.3% base).
tips.scouting_note: Slide-step filter 2026-10-05: glove-height CH vs SL is the same eye tell, split into three runner settings (empty · 1B/13 · 12/loaded/2/3/23). Strongest in the 1B or 1st&3rd cell (classic slide-step). FDR not publish gate; tipsProtected. Cell: 1B or 1st&3rd (slide step).

tips.title: Depth of Sit at the Set · Changeup (CH) vs Slider (SL)
tips.cue: how deep he sits in the set
tips.target_body_part: back-leg knee bend / hip height at the set
tips.what_to_spot: Before changeups Straily sinks into the set — the back knee bends and the hips drop about an eighth of a torso length lower than on sliders, where he stands noticeably taller and straighter over the rubber. Read it at the set, before the glove ever moves.
tips.direction: Deeper sit / more knee bend at the set → Changeup; taller, straighter set → Slider.
tips.lookFor: Deeper sit / more knee bend at the set → Changeup; taller, straighter set → Slider. (2.50× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: back-leg knee bend / hip height at the set
tips.fires_vs_random: When this cue fires: 60.7% CH (vs 53.2% base).
tips.scouting_note: Roupp-style visual QA 2026-10-05: quantitative floors cleared on the re-scored stretch pool (readable separation + holdout precision above base rate); A/B frame pack not yet cut, so film confirm is still queued. FDR not used as publish gate; tipsProtected.

tips.title: Glove Set Elevation at Leg Lift Peak · Curveball (CU) vs Sinker/Changeup (SI/CH)
tips.cue: glove elevation at peak leg lift
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.1 · Window: -0.28s at Peak Leg Lift Apex (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)
tips.target_body_part: Glove Elevation at Leg Lift Peak (+0.06 torso lengths higher)
tips.what_to_spot: Roupp elevates the glove +0.06 torso lengths higher at the apex of leg lift on Curveballs compared to hard Sinkers and Changeups, giving hitters and base runners on second an early visual trigger before arm separation.
tips.direction: Roupp elevates the glove +0.06 torso lengths higher at the apex of leg lift on Curveballs compared to hard Sinkers and Changeups.
tips.lookFor: Roupp elevates the glove +0.06 torso lengths higher at the apex of leg lift on Curveballs compared to hard Sinkers and Changeups (5.9× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove elevation relative to sternum/letters at the top of the high leg kick apex.
tips.fires_vs_random: Elevated glove apex yields 88.6% curveball execution (vs 44.5% baseline).
tips.scouting_note: Broadcast CF PoC: High glove apex on CU provides clean high-contrast separation.

tips.title: Settle-to-Lift Tempo & Hold Cadence · Secondary (CU/CH) vs Sinker (SI)

tips.target_body_part: Settle-to-Lift Tempo Cadence & Delivery Hold Duration

tips.title: Glove Pocket Flare & Webbing Angle at Lift Apex · Curveball vs Sinker
tips.cue: glove pocket outward flare at balance point
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.7 · Window: -0.20s at Peak Leg Lift Apex (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.what_to_spot: At the top of the balance point, Roupp flares the glove pocket slightly outward (11°) on the curveball to prevent thumb drag during arm drop, exposing the open mitt leather toward second base.
tips.spot_the_difference: At the apex of leg lift, Roupp flares the glove pocket outward 11° on Curveballs to clear his curveball grip, exposing the inside leather to 2B runners, whereas on Sinkers the glove face stays dead square to home plate.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: At t=-0.20s (lift apex), compare mitt pocket angle. Outward canted web = Curveball; square web = Sinker.
tips.direction: At the top of the balance point, Roupp flares the glove pocket slightly outward on the curveball to prevent thumb drag during arm drop, exposing the open mitt leather toward second base.
tips.lookFor: At the top of the balance point, Roupp flares the glove pocket slightly outward on the curveball to prevent thumb drag during arm drop, exposing the open mitt leather toward second base (4.2× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Glove pocket flare angle toward second base at the apex of the lead knee drive.
tips.fires_vs_random: Outward pocket flare yields 83.5% curveball execution.
tips.scouting_note: Physical adaptation ensuring clean curveball release path.

tips.title: Sideways Glove Drift into Stride Initiation · Sinker vs Secondary
tips.cue: sideways glove drift into lift
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.5 · Window: -0.08s at Stride Initiation (Video Frames -3 to 0)
tips.target_body_part: Arm-Side Lateral Glove Drift & Torso Spacing
tips.what_to_spot: On sinkers, Roupp drifts the glove slightly toward the arm side (1.5 inches) during stride initiation to create linear hip-shoulder separation.
tips.spot_the_difference: On Sinkers, Roupp drifts his hands +1.5 inches arm-side during stride initiation to build linear torque; on secondary pitches (CU/CH), his hands remain locked on the chest centerline.
tips.side_by_side_guide: In side-by-side video sync: Track horizontal glove position as the front foot begins forward stride. Arm-side drift = Sinker; centered glove = Secondary.
tips.direction: On sinkers, Roupp drifts the glove toward the arm side; on secondary pitches the glove remains centered.
tips.lookFor: On sinkers, Roupp drifts the glove toward the arm side; on secondary pitches the glove remains centered (3.1× separation floor).
tips.what_to_look_at: Lateral glove drift relative to center chest as stride initiates.
tips.fires_vs_random: Arm-side glove drift yields 78.2% sinker rate.
tips.scouting_note: Linear drive mechanic maximizing horizontal tail on sinker.
